name: Batwheels
description: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

videos.title: Meet the Batwheels
videos.overview: An action-packed music video of the Batwheels' most exciting adventures set to an extended version of the series' theme song.

videos.title: Calling All Batwheels
videos.overview: A music video introducing all of Batman's heroic vehicle squad - the Batwheels - showcasing their incredible gadgets, stunning talents, and unique personalities.

videos.title: Bam!
videos.overview: Set to his rocking theme song, Bam the Batmobile takes to the streets of Gotham and uses his smarts, leadership skills, and awesome gadgets to fight crime and stop the villainous Legion of Zoom.

videos.title: Buff Tuff
videos.overview: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

videos.title: Faster
videos.overview: It's time to go, go, go with Batgirl's motorbike Bibi as she zigs and zags her way to victory in this high-energy music video - it doesn't matter if it's a stunt jump or a speeding supervillain, Bibi always gives it her all and then some!

videos.title: Fly
videos.overview: Tour the glittering night sky with Batwing, Gotham's flying protector with a penchant for posing, as she dips, dives, and dodges through buildings and water to take on villains and bail out a friend or two - set to her funky-fresh theme song.

videos.title: Spooky Batcave
videos.overview: A series of spooky sounds and sights leads the Batwheels to believe that the Batcave is haunted by a B-B-Bat-Ghost!

videos.title: Robin's Ride
videos.overview: Robin's ride Redbird is on the case in this radical music video, as he sneaks and sleuths his way to stop Gotham's villains with his speed and detective skills - it's no mystery why Redbird is one of the best!

videos.title: Bam's Bubble Trouble
videos.overview: An errant piece of bubblegum stuck inside Bam threatens to blow up Batman's chance at stopping Joker on a fast-paced mission through the Gotham streets.

videos.title: Wheelin' and Dealin'
videos.overview: After losing one of his wheels on his way to stop Prank, Bam comically attempts to replace his tire with all sorts of zany objects while chasing the prankster van around the city.

videos.title: Interview with a Crime-Fighter
videos.overview: Batman discusses the Batmobile's amazing capabilities and features during an interview at Gotham's auto show, featuring impressive clips of Bam in action as he swoops in to save the day.

videos.title: The Best Present in the World
videos.overview: A heart-warming holiday-themed music video where the Batwheels sing about what's most important to them - friendship.

videos.title: Silly Stowaway
videos.overview: The Batcave's cutest resident bat Alfie sneaks into Bam the Batmobile and causes adorable chaos during a mission to stop the Ducky Boat down at Gotham Docks.

videos.title: The Knight Shift
videos.overview: Bam can't wait to recharge after a long night of heroism in Gotham, but first, the Batwheels need all kinds of help, delaying his much-needed nap just a little bit longer...

videos.title: Rockin' Robin
videos.overview: Redbird gushes about his favorite hero and driver - Robin - as he shows off their action-packed adventures and gadgets in his own personal vlog.

videos.title: Bibi Bops
videos.overview: Bam, Redbird, Bibi, Batwing, and Buff are thrust into hijinks and action as they learn important lessons about teamwork, friendship, and so much more while helping Batman, Robin, and Batgirl defend Gotham.

videos.title: Batwingin' It
videos.overview: Batwing flies high over Gotham in her video diary as she shares exciting tips and tricks to what makes her brand of crimefighting so special!

videos.title: Bad to the Chrome
videos.overview: A music video introducing the villainous vehicle squad - The Legion of Zoom - introducing their shifty skills and pernicious personalities.

videos.title: A Joking Matter
videos.overview: A musical montage features the Joker, Gotham's most prickling prankster, as he causes trouble big and small for Batman, the Batwheels, and Gothamites alike!

videos.title: Parking Problems
videos.overview: The Batwheels face off with the Legion of Zoom as they attempt to recover Batman's stolen cowl from the villainous vehicles.

videos.title: Bat Surfin'
videos.overview: Surf-riding musical mayhem with Batman, Robin, and the Batwheels!

videos.title: I'll Be Your Shelter
videos.overview: A musical tribute to Ace, the super-brave bat-hound!

videos.title: Jet Set
videos.overview: Take to the skies over Gotham with Batwing and her friend best jet-friend Goldie the Arrowplane!

videos.title: Bad Day
videos.overview: Bam gushes over his personal hero and idol - Batman! During an ongoing mission, Bam awes at all the cool moves and awesome antics that Batman shows off.

videos.title: Secret Origin of the Batwheels
videos.overview: When Batman, Robin, and Batgirl are captured, the Batcomputer brings the Bat-Vehicles to life. The newly-minted Batwheels must defend the Batcave and face off with the Legion of Zoom – all without Batman’s help!

videos.title: Stop That Ducky!
videos.overview: After snagging an ultra-fuel-cell upgrade, Penguin's Ducky Boat suddenly becomes the fastest vehicle in Gotham City. Confident leader Bam must rally the Batwheels to stop the turbo-Ducky!

videos.title: Buff's BFF
videos.overview: When Buff befriends Mr. Freeze's snowcrawler Snowy, the other Batwheels bristle at the thought of hanging out with a "bad guy... " so Buff sets out to change their minds.

videos.title: Up in the Air
videos.overview: After he causes the Batwing to crash, Bam becomes obsessed with making it up to her during a high-stakes aerial mission against Penguin and his giant ducky blimp.

videos.title: Bibi's Do-Over
videos.overview: Everyone is ecstatic when Bibi, Batgirl, and Robin capture Toyman and his Do-Over remote - except for Bibi, who failed to stick the landing on a big jump. Unwilling to accept her failure, Bibi uses Toyman's Do-Over remote until she perfects her jump!

videos.title: Sidekicked to the Curb
videos.overview: When Bam is sent to take on Prank, Redbird is forced to hang back because The Joker's van is too dangerous! When Bam discovers that Redbird secretly tagged along, he's upset... until Redbird bails him out of a tight spot.

videos.title: Keep Calm and Roll On
videos.overview: After Jestah's insults get the best of her, a short-tempered Bibi tries to not let the big-wheeled bully's words get to her so she can help Batgirl catch Harley.

videos.title: Bam's Upgrade
videos.overview: Feeling neglected after being passed over on missions, Bam asks MOE to install experimental upgrades to curry Batman's favor. But, when Bam's new powers are stronger than he can control, Batman - and the mission - are suddenly in danger!

videos.title: Redbird's Bogus Beach Day
videos.overview: Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! But when the Joker and his van Prank show up unexpectedly and ruin Redbird's beach day plans, Bam helps him realize that even though things didn't go exactly as planned, they still had a great day!

videos.title: Cave Sweet Cave
videos.overview: After the Joker floods the Batcave, the Batwheels evacuate and relocate to a nearby parking garage. As they adapt to their temporary home, they learn important lessons about family and making the most of what you have.

videos.title: Scaredy-Bat
videos.overview: When Batman refuses to engage Joker in a race, Prank goads Bam into a rematch. Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares and take the high road?

videos.title: Riddle Me This
videos.overview: After struggling to solve a riddle from Riddler's helicopter Quizz, Redbird must learn to speak up and share his ideas with the Batwheels if they hope to figure out the villain's true scheme.

videos.title: Zoomsday
videos.overview: The Legion of Zoom is tired of always losing. They decide to take a page from the Batwheels and try using teamwork in order to pull off a daring heist. But will they be able to work together?

videos.title: Rev and Let Rev
videos.overview: Redbird sacrifices his stealth muffler tech to sound as loud as the other Batwheels but his modifications backfire when Robin needs his stealthy skills to catch the elusive Catwoman!

videos.title: Batcomputer for a Day
videos.overview: When Batcomputer shuts down for a system update, the other Batwheels must take over for her while aiding Batman in a battle against Harley Quinn.

videos.title: Grass Is Greener
videos.overview: MOE wants to know what it's like to be a member of the Batwheels, but the bot gets more than he bargained for when Bam invites him along for an exciting mission to stop Poison Ivy.

videos.title: Holidays on Ice
videos.overview: Frustrated by the Batwheels' holiday distractions, Batwing decides to "go solo" to thwart Mr. Freeze's evil Christmas-time plot. But Batwing soon realizes how hard it is to stop Mr. Freeze on her own!

videos.title: Bam's Clawful Mistake
videos.overview: Bam brings Catwoman's Catmobile, Kitty, to life so the Batwheels can have even teams for their game of "Bat-Ball," but the Kitty "Kitty" is too wild to be contained, despite Bam's best attempts to convince her to play along.

videos.title: Harley Did It
videos.overview: Everyone assumes that Harley Quinn is the culprit in a recent burglary. But as Batman and Bam pursue Harley, Bibi and Redbird begin to suspect that she may actually be innocent.

videos.title: Buff in a China Shop
videos.overview: Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Bibis
videos.overview: Badcomputer captures Bibi and disguises Jestah to take her place with the Batwheels so that Jestah can steal the Batcomputer's motherboard. Can Bibi get free in time to unmask the imposter and save the day?

videos.title: Batty Race
videos.overview: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to emsure the race is won the right way, fair and square !

videos.title: When You're A Jet
videos.overview: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

videos.title: Ride Along
videos.overview: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

videos.title: Wheels Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

videos.title: Tough Buff Blues
videos.overview: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname "Tough Buff." But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

videos.title: Wheel Side Story
videos.overview: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

videos.title: Ace in the Hole
videos.overview: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

videos.title: Mechanic Panic
videos.overview: When Jestah injures herself preparing for an extreme sports competition with the other Zoomers, Bibi helps her overcome her fear of going to the mechanic so she can heal up in time to compete.

videos.title: Improvise My Ride
videos.overview: When Buff's trusty winch is knocked out of action by Poison Ivy, he must learn to improvise and come up with creative solutions on the fly.

videos.title: Dynamic Du-Oh-No
videos.overview: When Snowy and Jestah team up to execute a mysterious plan involving rare freeze-berries, Batwing and Buff pair up to take on the dastardly duo, but Batwing decides to carry out the mission herself, putting both her and Buff at risk.

videos.title: To the Batmobile!
videos.overview: When all of the Batwheels (except for Bam) mysteriously disappear, Bam enlists the help of A.D.A.M, the original Batmobile, to help save his friends. Along the way, Bam comes to appreciate the old-school mobile's different crimefighting style as they team up to take on the Legion of Zoom.

videos.title: The Dark Night
videos.overview: Much to everyone's surprise, Bam is secretly afraid of the dark. When Poison Ivy knocks out all the power in Gotham, Bam must conquer his fears to stop her.

videos.title: License to Joke
videos.overview: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as "V-8, the Super-Spy", he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

videos.title: Bibi's Bad Day
videos.overview: Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn't think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a "bad today" doesn't mean it'll be a "bad tomorrow."

videos.title: A Jet Out of Water
videos.overview: After refusing to practice with her new underwater mode, Batwing is unable to save Batman from Penguin's sunken ship trap. The Batwheels must help Wing practice her submersible skills before she can save the day.

videos.title: Batty Body Swap
videos.overview: After agreeing to swap motherboards and change bodies, the Batwheels have to quickly learn to "drive a mile in each other's wheels" in time to stop the approaching Legion of Zoom!

videos.title: Nightbike
videos.overview: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. These stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

videos.title: Bat-Light Blow-Out
videos.overview: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

videos.title: Kitty's Sleepover
videos.overview: Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task.

videos.title: Mission: Stuffed Animal
videos.overview: When Redbird takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking, Red enlists Bam to help him make a daring rescue.

videos.title: Follow the Bouncing Bam
videos.overview: When Bam is covered in Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage.

videos.title: Big Rig Bam
videos.overview: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he's tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

videos.title: Air-Show Don't Tell
videos.overview: Batwing and Goldie secretly decide to participate in the Gotham Air-Show, but when Batman needs their help, they must choose between winning the competition and their responsibilities to fight crime.

videos.title: Monster Truck Amok
videos.overview: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He's too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.

videos.title: Razzle Dazzle Frazzle
videos.overview: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

videos.title: Multi-MOE
videos.overview: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

videos.title: The Ulti-Bat Rises
videos.overview: When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur.

videos.title: A T-Rexcellent Adventure
videos.overview: Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum's famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

videos.title: Bats in Show
videos.overview: Gotham's annual dog show is tonight, and Harley plans to compete for the prized "Best in Show" ribbon.

videos.title: The Gotham Guardians
videos.overview: Bam must lead a new super vehicle team after the Legion of Zoom traps the rest of the Batwheels in the Batcave.

videos.title: Save the Bat Dance for Me
videos.overview: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but it's up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

videos.title: Nightbike's Noisy Night
videos.overview: After Nightbike reveals that he's afraid of loud noises, the Batwheels help him overcome his fear.

videos.title: Bite-Sized Buff
videos.overview: Feeling insecure about his size after a game of Hide-and-Seek, Buff uses the shrink belt belonging to The Atom.

videos.title: Redbird-O-Flage
videos.overview: Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight.

videos.title: Pumpkin Panic
videos.overview: On Halloween Night, Poison Ivy brings all the pumpkins to life, creating an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that are eating all the candy.

videos.title: The Wizard of Bats
videos.overview: Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself!

videos.title: The Great Christmas Caper
videos.overview: When Santa's sleigh is damaged, the Batwheels must help Santa deliver presents to the children of Gotham.

videos.title: The Batgirlmobile
videos.overview: With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree.

videos.title: Music Meister Mayhem
videos.overview: Music Meister steals the singing voices of all the people in Gotham, and bashful Buff must gain the confidence in his own voice.

videos.title: Batwing and the Nets
videos.overview: When Batwing's favorite Bat-Net gets ripped during a chase with Riddler, she must learn to let go of her old net.

videos.title: Clay Date
videos.overview: Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day.

videos.title: Wish Upon a Car
videos.overview: Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him!

videos.title: Bibi's Bat-Belt Blunder
videos.overview: Bibi just can't put down her new exciting video game, even when MOE needs her help packing Bam's utility belt for a mission.

videos.title: Lend Me Your Volunteer
videos.overview: Buff tries to show Batwing how great it is to volunteer to help Gotham's needy, but the Legion of Zoom gets in the way.

videos.title: Condiment Chaos!
videos.overview: Condiment King takes advantage of no Batwheels being on patrol to unleash a barrage of ketchup and mustard on an unsuspecting Gotham.

videos.title: Bat-Blast-Off!
videos.overview: When King Tut steals an ancient artifact that makes his Carcophagus magically fast, MOE equips Bam with rocket boosters to catch the villain.

videos.title: Flight of the Kitty
videos.overview: Now that Catwoman has equipped Kitty with wings, Batwing tries to teach the easily-distracted Kitty how to fly.

videos.title: The Bestah Way
videos.overview: When Harley Quinn's Hyena goes missing, Bibi agrees to help Jestah look for her.

videos.title: MOE Alone
videos.overview: A sneaky trick strands the Batwheels at the docks, clearing the way for a Batcave heist by the Legion of Zoom.

videos.title: Bat-Buds Forever
videos.overview: Bibi and Batwing must work together to get past the Legion of Zoom in order to deliver a new giant screen to Batcomputer.

videos.title: Banebuggy
videos.overview: The Batwheels take on a new vehicular villain who keeps growing bigger and bigger while learning that size doesn't always win the day.

videos.title: Spiffledipped
videos.overview: While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave, the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet.

videos.title: Bibi and the Bad Seed
videos.overview: When Poison Ivy uses a rare pollen-spewing flower to put all of Gotham to sleep, it's up to Bibi to save her friends and save the day.

videos.title: Gotham, We Have a Problem⁩
videos.overview: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him!

videos.title: ⁨Betterwheels⁩
videos.overview: The Legion of Zoom wants to prove they're better than the Batwheels at doing good for Gotham, so they form their own super-team!

videos.title: The Tumbler Begins⁩
videos.overview: Batman calls on his newest, amazingly flexible vehicle -- the Tumbler -- to help him navigate the Joker's funhouse lair.

videos.title: Sizzie Strong
videos.overview: Bibi and Batgirl are surprised to run into Harley and Jestah at their favorite popstar's concert, and now they've all got to team up to save the show!

videos.title: It's My Bat Birthday Too, Yeah
